verified_facts.text: Le Sereno is a St. Barths hotel located on the waters of the Grand Cul De Sac.
verified_facts.excerpt: Welcome to Le Sereno, an iconic St. Barths hotel located on the ultra-private crystal-clear waters of the Grand Cul De Sac.

verified_facts.text: Le Sereno is an intimate beachfront resort known for its contemporary design and understated luxury service.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our intimate beachfront resort has long beckoned travelers for its contemporary design and understated luxury service.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation categories include the Grand Suite Plage, the Grand Suite Plage Sud, the Bungalow Piscine and the Sereno Villas.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own spa, Le Sereno Spa.
Each Le Sereno Villa offers more than 7,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space in half an acre of private landscaped garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of the three Villas offer more than 7,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor space in a half an acre of private landscaped garden.

verified_facts.text: Each villa has three to four bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen and expansive terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: each private villa features three to four bedrooms, large living areas, fully equipped kitchen, expansive terraces

verified_facts.text: Each villa has a heated private pool overlooking the Grand Cul-de-Sac.
verified_facts.excerpt: heated private pools overlooking the magnificent views over the Grand Cul-de Sac

verified_facts.text: The villas have a wood-paneled library with a media room and surround-sound large-screen home theater.
verified_facts.excerpt: Wood-paneled Library with en-suite bathroom. Media room, surround-sound large screen home theater.

verified_facts.text: The villa kitchens have aluminum Schiffini cabinets by Vico Magistretti.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fully equipped designer kitchen with aluminum Schiffini cabinets by Vico Magistretti

verified_facts.text: The villas have a large covered terrace with a panoramic ocean view, a dining table and a lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large Covered terrace with panoramic ocean view with dining table (seats 8 comfortably) and lounge.
